commands.label: Inspect output stream API of the official KoLmafia runtime
Invoke the unchanged ASH file in KoLmafia with console capture

logging_fields: public static java.io.PrintStream openStream(java.lang.String, java.io.PrintStream, boolean);
semantic_scope: The genuine KoLmafia interpreter executed the original ASH entry point. The configured console logger captured its actual greeting.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
